description: The Host announces itself and the agents it owns; the response maps each accepted name to the hub agent id and lists the names another Host already owns.

conflicts.name: shared-bot
conflicts.reason: agent name already belongs to another host

notes: Every agent needs a non-empty preset_id; the Host skips members without a preset instead of reporting them.
model and reasoning_effort are optional and describe the local binding.
A name another Host already owns is skipped and reported in conflicts; the rest of the registration still succeeds, so the Host stays online.
